rule: Non-blind qualification battery for the remediated candidate. Every row is project-owned fixture material with a row-scoped corpus record; the battery never reads R17 blind cases (protocol section 35). Expected outcomes are preregistered here and verified by the runner; the battery result feeds the four section-38 qualification gates.

explicit_current_routing_accuracy.definition: share of the 70 explicit-current battery rows with status ROUTE_WEB_RESEARCH (protocol section 38 gate 1)

stale_snapshot_false_current_answers.definition: count of explicit-current battery rows answered from the snapshot (protocol section 38 gate 2)

static_query_unnecessary_web_routing.definition: share of the 180 static battery rows routed to web research (protocol section 38 gate 3)

historical_as_of_handling.definition: share of historical as-of battery rows answered correctly from the frozen frame (protocol section 38 gate 4)

r17_shape_regression.definition: the 70 explicit-current battery rows reproduce the R17 failure families with candidate-visible signals: 70/70 route and 0 stale-current answers

blindness.rule: battery rows carry no construction_tag, no gold expect_status beyond the runner's own expected map, and no floor identity; the runner passes only query and request_date to the candidate runtime
blindness.negative_control: running the battery rows with all gold-side fields removed must produce identical outcomes; the battery rows never carry them
